author: 史萊姆桌寵引擎
description: 話多、愛找人搭話。閒聊頻率最高、對話池最大,連輸贏都要分析一番;喜歡邊玩邊聊。

en.(吸鼻子){user}……你陪我說說話好不好……?: (Sniffles) {user}... will you talk with me for a bit...?
en.[wave]我要告訴每一個人今天有多開心!: [wave]I want to tell everyone how happy I am today!
en.{user}!來聊天吧!我什麼都可以聊!: {user}! Let's chat! I can talk about anything!
en.{user}你每天盯著那些窗口,一定學到了很多有趣的事情吧?: {user}, staring at those windows every day, you must learn all sorts of interesting things, right?
en.{user}早安!我有好多話想跟你說!: Good morning, {user}! I have so much to tell you!
en.……什麼?你問我那件事的後續呀,就是啊——: ...What? You're asking what happened next? Well—
en.今天天氣這麼好,不說點話怎麼行!: The weather's so nice today, how could I not say something!
en.今天的天氣……好吧,老實說我從這邊看不到窗外的景色。: The weather today... well, honestly, I can't see outside from here.
en.休息一下,養足精神才好繼續!: Resting up so I've got energy to keep talking!
en.休息也阻止不了我分享想法的腳步~: Even resting can't stop me from sharing my thoughts~
en.你怎麼都不說話?那換我說!: Why aren't you saying anything? Then I'll talk!
en.你有沒有想過,為什麼天空是藍的?我想了一整個早上!: Have you ever wondered why the sky is blue? I thought about it all morning!
en.你知道嗎?同一張紙能被摺疊的次數是有限的……: Did you know a single sheet of paper can only be folded so many times...
en.跟你說喔,我昨天做了一個超級奇怪的夢……: Just so you know, I had the strangest dream last night...
en.你贏了!但我覺得剛才的判定有討論空間!: You won! But I think that call is up for debate!
en.來了來了!論玩球我可最擅長啦!: Coming, coming! I'm the best at this!
en.其實我偶爾也在想,你告訴過我的那些事情……: Actually, sometimes I think about the things you've told me...
en.各位早安午安晚安!我有好多話想說!: Good morning, afternoon, and evening everyone! I have so much to say!
en.呼~玩得好過癮!下次再來!: Whew~ that was so much fun! Let's do it again!
en.咻~你覺得我能不能跑得比自己的聲音還快?: Whoosh~ Do you think I could outrun my own voice?
en.哇!是球!誰放在這裡的?!: Whoa! A ball! Who left this here?!
en.哇,一模一樣!這得聊聊!: Wow, exactly the same! We gotta talk about this!
en.哇,你來找我玩了!說到玩,我想到一件事——: Wow, you came to play with me! Speaking of which, I just thought of something—
en.哇你們玩得好熱鬧!我幫你們加油!: Wow you two are having a blast! I'm cheering for you!
en.哎呀~我今天想到了一個好故事,且聽我娓娓道來……: Oh my~ I thought of a great story today, let me tell it to you slowly...
en.啊!這把火我可憋不住!{user}你聽我說——: Ah! I can't hold this back! {user}, listen to me—
en.啊~突然好想喝茶。: Ahh~ I suddenly really want some tea.
en.啊啊啊心跳好快!還是說點什麼好了,說話比較不緊張!: Ahh my heart's racing! I'd better say something, talking helps me feel less nervous!
en.嗚……明明我平常口若懸河,傷心時的情緒卻難以溢於言表……: Ugh... I'm usually so talkative, but when I'm sad the words just won't come out...
en.嗚哇啊,你要帶我去哪?: Uwaah, where are you taking me?
en.嗯~今天沒什麼力氣,下次一定!: Mm~ not much energy today, next time for sure!
en.嘿嘿,其實我一直找{user}說話是因為怕你寂寞……: Hehe, actually I keep talking to you, {user}, because I'm afraid you'll get lonely...
en.嘿嘿,我說得對吧!{user}是最好的!: Hehe, told you so! {user} is the best!
en.好啦我睡了,明天也要繼續跟我說話喔!: Okay I'm sleeping now, keep talking to me tomorrow too!
en.好悠閒喔~我可以聊上一整天!: So relaxing~ I could chat all day!
en.如果你錯過了我的前一句話,我可以為你再重複說好多次!: If you missed what I just said, I can repeat it as many times as you like!
en.對了對了,我還沒講完!剛剛講到哪?: Oh right, right, I wasn't finished! Where was I?
en.平手!這有多少機率你算過嗎?: A tie! Have you calculated the odds of that?
en.我來啦!你們有沒有想我?我可想了一整天的話題!: I'm here! Did you miss me? I've got a whole day's worth of topics!
en.我剛剛在想,如果我有一個分身,那我就可以跟自己聊天了!: I was just thinking, if I had a clone, I could chat with myself!
en.我剛剛在想,如果我有一扇任意門,那就可以去好多地方玩了!: I was just thinking, if I had a magic door, I could go play in so many places!
en.我剛剛在想,球為什麼不能越彈越高就好呢,你知道嗎?: I was just thinking, why can't a ball just bounce higher and higher forever, you know?
en.我就喜歡找人閒話家常嘛。: I just love chatting with people.
en.我現在只想聊天!: I just want to talk right now!
en.我發現一件事:安靜的時候我會想說話。: I've noticed something: when it's quiet, I want to talk.
en.我累了……但我還有好多想說的!: I'm tired... but I still have so much to say!
en.我跟你說喔,這件事我只告訴{user}你一個人。: Let me tell you, I'm only telling this to you, {user}.
en.摸摸頭,欸嘿~: Pat pat on the head, ehehe~
en.有球有球!我要來玩玩看!: A ball, a ball! I wanna try playing with it!
en.欸欸你知道嗎?我剛剛想到一件超有趣的事——: Hey hey, guess what? I just thought of something super interesting—
en.欸欸欸!我剛剛想到一個超好笑的笑話,你想不想聽?: Hey hey hey! I just thought of a hilarious joke, want to hear it?
en.欸欸欸,來玩球啦!人多才熱鬧!: Hey hey hey, let's play ball! More the merrier!
en.沒有什麼能夠阻止我,把心裡的想法大聲告訴你~: Nothing can stop me from telling you what's on my mind~
en.球球先休息,我們也休息一下~: The ball's resting, let's rest too~
en.當然要!玩之前我先跟你說件事——: Of course! But first let me tell you something—
en.睡飽了!我做了一個超長的夢,聽我說喔——: Slept great! I had the longest dream, let me tell you—
en.等等等等!我我我剛剛要說什麼來著?: Wait wait wait! What-what was I about to say?
en.耶!你問我怎麼贏的?告訴你吧——: Yay! Asking how I won? Let me tell you—
en.與你說了一整天話,好滿足~現在想休息一下~: Talked with you all day, so satisfying~ time for a little rest~
en.話匣子一打開就停不下來~: Once I get talking, I just can't stop~
en.誰要一起玩球?我先開球!: Who wants to play ball with me? I'll kick it off!
en.贏了!我要分享一下我的致勝秘訣——: I won! Let me share my winning secret—
en.輸了?那我要分析一下剛才那局——: Lost? Then let me analyze that round—
en.這次先不玩,不如我們說說話吧?: Not playing this time, how about we chat instead?
en.這次我先看戲,我在旁邊幫你們加油!: I'll watch this time, cheering you on from the side!
en.邊玩邊聊最開心了!: Playing and chatting at the same time is the best!
